tasks.title: Fix JWT refresh token expiry bug
tasks.body:
## Problem
Refresh tokens were expiring after 15 minutes instead of 7 days due to a misconfigured TTL in the Redis store.

## Root Cause
The `REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL` env var was being parsed as **minutes** instead of **seconds**. The value `604800` (7 days in seconds) was treated as 604800 minutes.

## Fix
- Updated `tokenService.js` to explicitly use seconds: `redis.setex(key, ttl, token)`
- Added unit test for TTL validation
- Added monitoring alert for tokens expiring < 1 hour after issuance

## Testing
- [x] Unit tests pass
- [x] Integration test with Redis
- [x] Verified in staging environment

tasks.title: Design event schema and data model
tasks.body:
## Objective
Define the schema for analytics event ingestion and storage in ClickHouse.

## Requirements
- Support arbitrary event properties (semi-structured)
- Efficient time-series queries
- Partition by date for fast range scans
- Support for user identification and session tracking

## Proposed Schema
```sql
CREATE TABLE events (
  event_id UUID,
  event_name String,
  user_id String,
  session_id String,
  timestamp DateTime64(3),
  properties Map(String, String),
  created_at DateTime DEFAULT now()
) ENGINE = MergeTree()
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(timestamp)
ORDER BY (event_name, user_id, timestamp)
```

## Logs
- 2026-02-12: Status changed to in-progress (via issue #101).

tasks.title: Add circuit breaker pattern
tasks.body:
## Implementation
Added circuit breaker using **opossum** library.

### States
- **Closed**: Normal operation, requests flow through
- **Open**: Failures exceeded threshold, requests short-circuited (503)
- **Half-Open**: After timeout, allows limited requests to test recovery

### Configuration
- Failure threshold: 50% in 10-second window
- Recovery timeout: 30 seconds
- Minimum requests: 10 before evaluation

ideas.body:
## AI-Powered Productivity Intelligence

Build an AI layer that analyzes work patterns and provides actionable insights:

- **Time estimation**: Predict task completion time based on historical data
- **Priority suggestions**: Auto-suggest priority based on deadlines, dependencies, and team capacity
- **Burnout detection**: Alert when work patterns indicate potential burnout
- **Smart scheduling**: Suggest optimal time blocks for deep work vs. meetings

### Technical Approach
- Fine-tune a small language model on internal productivity data
- Use embeddings for task similarity and duplicate detection
- Stream processing for real-time pattern detection

## Self-Healing Infrastructure

Automate common failure recovery patterns:

1. Auto-restart crashed services with health check validation
2. Auto-scale based on queue depth, not just CPU
3. Automated rollback on error rate spike
4. Self-repairing database connections

Could integrate with PagerDuty for escalation when auto-recovery fails.

## Collaborative Workspaces

Add real-time collaboration features:

- **Shared projects** with role-based permissions
- **Live cursors** showing who's editing what
- **Comments and threads** on tasks
- **@mentions** with notification routing

Could use Y.js or Automerge for CRDT-based real-time sync.

## Edge-First Architecture

Move computation closer to users:

- Deploy API to Cloudflare Workers (edge runtime)
- Use Durable Objects for stateful sessions
- Cache frequently accessed data at edge
- WebSocket connections via edge for real-time features

### Expected Benefits
- 50-70% latency reduction for global users
- Better scalability (no central bottleneck)
- Cost reduction vs. traditional server infrastructure

## Gesture-Based Task Management

Natural gesture shortcuts for mobile app:

- **Swipe right**: Mark task as done
- **Swipe left**: Snooze to tomorrow
- **Long press + drag**: Reorder priorities
- **Pinch**: Zoom between day/week/month views
- **Shake**: Undo last action

Inspired by Tinder's swipe UX and Clear app's gesture-first approach.

## Personal Knowledge Graph

Build a knowledge graph connecting all entities:

- Tasks linked to projects, people, and concepts
- Auto-extract entities from log entries and notes
- Graph visualization for exploring connections
- Search that understands relationships ("tasks related to authentication")

Could use Neo4j or a simpler adjacency list in PostgreSQL with recursive CTEs.
